three_points_one_idea_sentences: This study is about the nine-step ladder of intelligence.
Across 3.8 billion years of biology and 76 years of computing, intelligence climbs a nine-step ladder through one repeating signal ratchet.
Today's AI stalls at the fifth step—tool use—because routine jobs still wake giant models from scratch.
Crossing the compilation threshold unlocks the top four steps by turning verified answers into fast, low-energy lookup reflexes.
Key result: 98 / 100 Verified Synthesis · 9x–27x Board Power Gain.
Real power sensors on the circuit board measured the electricity.
